text:
incident-bot: Pager: Multiple 503s reported for inference in eu-west-1. High GPU allocation + queue spikes. Please join #incident-bridge if paged.

Alex P: I'm on it, joining bridge. noticing tail latency spike ~18:22 UTC.

Maria G: joining. customer reports degraded responses for batch traffic (embedding jobs). ETA: unknown.

Samir: can someone grab current autoscaler logs and recent scaling decisions? Suspect scale-down flaps.

Jin W: pulling autoscaler logs: `kubectl logs autoscaler-eu-1 --since=2h` shows repeated scale-downs at 16:45, 17:10, 17:40 then immediate scale-ups.

Troy: looks like we hit an island where capacity thin-provisioned + preemption -> pods stuck? seeing a bunch of GPU preempt events in cloud logs.

Alex P: customer impact: several enterprise tenants reported >2x latency, some 503s on streaming calls. Spike started ~16:30 and got worse after 17:00.

Maria G: @oncall-rotation can you confirm fallback routing to dedicated pool was available?

oncall-rotation: I tried failover but the routing policy didn't switch - requests kept hitting eu-west-1. Probably because pool compatibility check failed (model mismatch).

Samir: okay, immediate mitigation plan: 1) open bridge (done), 2) pin traffic to eu-west-fallback (manual routing), 3) spin extra dedicated nodes in eu-west and sa-east, 4) enable temporal rate-limit for embeddings.

Alex P: I'm doing manual route override: `POST /routing/override {"region":"eu-west-fallback","reason":"incident 1759123456"}`

ops-bot: Route override accepted, traffic shifting to eu-west-fallback. Estimated ramp 45s.

Maria G: spinning up dedicated nodes: `infra-cli reserve-nodes --pool eu-west-fallback --count 6 --type p4d` (kicking off).

Jin W: while nodes come up, enable short TTL KV cache for prefix caching to reduce token compute. Patch applied to runtime config: `cache.prefix_ttl=10s`

Troy: watch metrics: queued requests dropped ~30% after route override. latency improving but still higher than baseline.

Alex P: remote preemption logs show two large jobs kicked GPUs and never correctly released KV cache -> causing OOMs? putting kill policy to recycle pods older than 2h.

Samir: adding automated recycler: `kubectl annotate deployment/runtime recycle-after=2h` until we have safer fix.

Maria G: customer comms: draft status update for affected tenants? I'll send short note: root cause under investigation, mitigation in progress, will follow up with postmortem.

Alex P: agree. Maria please coordinate with CS.

Maria G: pinging @customer-success for distribution list.

ops-bot: Node provisioning complete, 6 nodes added to eu-west-fallback.

Alex P: traffic fully on fallback, error rate down to 0.7% from 4.5%, median latency back to ~1.2x baseline.

Samir: next action: schedule post-incident review (PIR) and create remediation tickets. I opened an initial tracker: https://jira.company/RED-9876 (will add tasks).

Jin W: immediate remediation items I recommend: 1) autoscaler hysteresis bump (prevent flapping), 2) route compatibility checks to allow compatible model variants fallback, 3) fail-open routing path when fallback pool healthy.

Troy: ops items: 1) ensure preemptible job isolation (quota cgroup), 2) automated KV cache cleanup on pod preempt, 3) recyclers with graceful drain.

Alex P: deployment/safety item: add a canary check for routing overrides so we can fallback on bad compatibility detection.

Maria G: scheduling PIR: proposed Wed 09:00 UTC. Who can own the postmortem?

Samir: I'll own the writeup. Maria can do customer impact summary. Jin and Troy to own infra remediation.

Maria G: creating calendar invite and linking to tracker.

incident-bot: Incident 1759123456 resolved: mitigation applied, services stable. Incident severity: Sev2.

Alex P: follow-ups: short-term PRs this week, longer-term changes in Q2 roadmap. I'll add a note to Optimize backlog for model-variant fallback.

Jin W: started a branch with autoscaler hysteresis patch: `git/infra:autoscale/hysteresis-1759` will open PR today.

Troy: created infra ticket RED-9890 for pod recycler + preempt cleanup logic.

Samir: action list summary (I'll paste into JIRA):
- Autoscaler: increase decision window + hysteresis (owner: Jin)
- Routing: allow model-compatible fallback and canary override (owner: Alex)
- Pod lifecycle: recycler with kv cache cleanup on preempt (owner: Troy)
- Observability: add per-route token-level SLO alert for queue growth (owner: Ops)
- Customer comms: post-incident email and timeline (owner: Maria)

Maria G: sent initial customer note. Will send final after PIR.

Alex P: oncall handoff: I'm handing to @oncall-rotation for night coverage, will be reachable if anything pops.

oncall-rotation: taking handoff. Thanks Alex. Will monitor til 02:00 UTC.

Samir: closing bridge in 10m unless any objections.

Troy: no objections.

Maria G: thanks team :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Bridge closed by Samir at 18:47 UTC.

Alex P: adding retrospective note: our fallback model-compatibility check should be more permissive for lower-quality variants when capacity constrained.

Samir: noted — we'll include decision matrix in PIR.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem draft due in 72 hours.

Maria G: acknowledged — will coordinate edits on the doc.

Alex P: filed customer-impact table in RED-9876 with affected tenants and timelines.

Jin W: will target autoscaler PR by end of day Friday.

Troy: I'll schedule a follow-up 1:1 with infra next week to prioritize RED-9890.

Maria G: closing notes: excellent coordination, keep the remediation items concise and timeboxed.

Samir: incident thread closed.
